name: Farm Management Suite
title: Farm Excel Suite: Crop Plan, Spraying, Fertiliser, Livestock, Milk and Eggs, Machinery, Sales, Grants, Loans, 15 Languages
headline: Run a whole farm from eight connected Excel workbooks
seo_title: Farm Excel Templates – Crops, Livestock, Machinery, Finance
seo_description: Eight Excel workbooks for farmers: crop plan, spray records, inputs, livestock, production, machinery, sales and farm finance. 15 languages.
description:
A farm runs on dates and small numbers that are easy to lose: a spray applied before the pre-harvest interval ended, a cow still under medicine withdrawal in the milk tank, a fertiliser order that arrives after the window, a field that makes a loss nobody noticed, a grant deadline buried in a drawer. They hide in diaries, notebooks and spreadsheets that never agree with each other.

This suite gives a working farmer, a farm manager or a growing farm business eight connected workbooks with sample data already inside: crop planning, fields and seasons; field operations, spraying and harvest; inputs, fertiliser and irrigation; livestock, health, breeding and feed; production, storage and traceability; machinery, fuel and labour; sales, contracts and buyers; and farm finance, grants, loans and compliance. Every page fills in by itself from what you type: totals, due dates, withdrawal and harvest intervals, margins per hectare, alerts, dashboards and charts.

Each workbook comes in 15 languages, with documents, checklists and ready WhatsApp messages for buyers, staff, contractors and suppliers. Clear the sample rows, type your own, and the whole farm is in one place, from the first sowing to the last invoice.
features: Season plan per field with sowing and harvest checks
Crop rotation check, seed plan and gross margin per hectare
Spray records with dose, wind and pre-harvest interval alerts
Fertiliser plan, input stock, orders and irrigation water cost
Herd and flock register with ear tags, births and weights
Vaccinations, treatments and medicine withdrawal periods
Feed rations, days of feed on hand and grazing rotation
Milk, egg and harvest lots with storage and traceability
Machinery hours, fuel use, servicing and seasonal worker pay
Sales contracts, buyer prices, invoices and late payments
Profit per field and per herd, budget and cash forecast
Loans, grants, insurance and compliance records ready for inspection

faq.a: No. The files are standard xlsx files that open in Microsoft Excel and in LibreOffice Calc, which is free.

faq.q: Does it suit a small family farm and a larger farm business?
faq.a: Yes. It works for a few fields or twenty; the sample data shows a mixed farm of about 600 hectares with eighteen fields, twelve crops, ten herds and flocks, and fourteen machines.

faq.q: Can I replace the sample data with my own?
faq.a: Yes. Clear the sample rows and type or paste yours; lists, formulas, alerts, dashboards and calculators update by themselves.

faq.q: Which currency and units does it use?
faq.a: You choose the currency on the Start sheet; areas, weights and volumes use metric units such as hectares, kilograms, tonnes and litres.
Open the workbook in your language, fill the yellow cells on the Start sheet, then follow the How to use it steps.

faq.q: Are there macros or a subscription?
faq.a: No macros and no add-ins: only formulas, so the files are safe to open. One payment, instant download.
